newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 10.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

** The Dow Jones industrial average ended 36.15 points lower at 5,930.62 on Wednesday, which was its sharpest fall since Sept. 5, when it dropped 49.94 points on nervousness over upcoming corporate earnings reports and an unfounded rumour that Russian President Boris Yeltsin had died.

** Jakarta District Court judge due to announce whether he has jurisdiction to hear the case brought by former minority party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri against the government, police and military over her ousting as head of Indonesian Democratic Party.
Case due to start at 0200 gmt.

** The Jakarta composite index fell 1.47 percent, or 8.46 points, to close at 566.32 points after touching an intra-day low of 563.31 points on Wednesday under the weight of selected market heavyweights but the downside was capped by bargain hunters.
** On Thursday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,320.75/21.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,320.50/21.00.
** Engineering firm Bukaka on reports that the firm was building automotive parts in West Java.
** Footwear manufacturer Ganda Wangsa on talk of a possible acquisition.
** Property firm Lippo Land on announcement of a sharp jump in its 12 months net profit ending June 30, 1996.
** Sampoerna on a recent $400-million loan which the cigarette giant said was for "corporate development", but analysts said the purpose was considered vague as it lacked details.
